scientific_scope_status: The only acquired evidence is the completed P3 response, reporting local working derivations without independent review. available_evidence_sources.quote: **I obtained a stronger construction and a matching quantitative principle: negativity and relative likelihood jointly control the attainable entropy advantage.** The construction maintains a fixed gap after **10% local signal depolarization**, at every positive negativity budget. The accompanying bound explains why that gap disappears when the hypotheses’ relative likelihood is bounded.

unavailable_or_unclassified: Governing proof/code/check originals are unacquired under binding no-upload/no-export/no-repackaging/no-alternate-transfer restrictions; no retry is made. Signal marginals agree and reference marginals differ. Separate hypothesis preparation can make a/w large; one common channel on an unknown input cannot create it from a bounded relative-likelihood pair. Global white-noise replacement has a different contract. General fixed-gap decision/hardness stays open and prior no-cutoff is SLD-specific.
